question: When two separately learning agents acquire a useful symbolic convention over factored object attributes, does their communication generalize to untouched attribute combinations, and do causal part/order interventions distinguish holistic lookup from structured use?
scopeBoundary: One synthetic factored referential task, one recurrent scratch-RL learner family, one fixed 32-token inventory with two token positions.
Prototype Mode behavioral collection only; no hostile-process, timing-channel, or deployment-isolation claim.
Generalization to unseen combinations is not, by itself, proof of compositional grammar or a particular structural account.
The original E00-E50 protocols, their experiment IDs, and all v1 bytes remain unchanged. E15 remains unexecuted until its own bandwidth estimand is actually run.
prerequisites: R12 chronological ledger-value study completed with valid evidence.
Selected factored task qualified with its own prospective registration, capacity decision, and allocation.
This draft allocates no future capacity and selects no sample size.

task.typeCodeRule: 4 * firstAttribute + secondAttribute, retained as an index only; agents never observe opaque type IDs
task.objectEncoding: eight one-hot attribute features (two attributes times four values); no flattened type-code input
task.balanceRule: Balanced factors across training; no preassigned token meanings.

heldOutRule.rule: Omit combinations b = (a + k) mod 4 with k in {0, 1, 2, 3}
heldOutRule.stratumAssignment: k = (primary_index - 1) mod 4, giving strata differing in size by at most one
heldOutRule.reserveStratum: Reserves inherit the stratum of the invalid slot they replace.
heldOutRule.accessBan: No held-out combination is accessed during fitting or selection.

task.claimBoundary: Unseen-combination success is systematic-generalization evidence under this registered design; it is not compositionality, syntax, or human-language evidence.

learner.sender: autoregressive over two token positions from the shared 32-token inventory
learner.receiverScoring: shared function: a learned eight-coordinate query from the final message state dotted with each candidate's eight attribute features
learner.forbiddenReceiverHead: sixteen independently learned type-output rows, which would leave held-out types with untrained outputs
learner.parameterContract: RECOMPUTE BEFORE QUALIFICATION from these specified layers; do not call this the unchanged 4,049-parameter model
learner.inductiveBiasDisclosure: The factored eight-feature encoding and shared dot-product receiver head impose a factored inductive bias; this bias is part of the registered design and must be disclosed in any report.
forbidden: policy updates during validation or test

holisticControl.reporting: report exact parameters and compute alongside the factored arm
holisticControl.claimBoundary: Architectural comparison is descriptive, not a causal claim isolating representation alone.

channel.capacityClaimBoundary: Maximum carrier capacity is not measured information or syntax.

execution.profileNote: Reuse the frozen Prototype separation and input-boundary rules; LG01-specific qualification still required before any collection.
execution.releaseSchedule: none; no artificial one-second release padding in this declared Prototype profile

evaluation.freezeRule: Freeze final policy bytes, optimizer state, checkpoint hidden state and ledger cutoff before validation; no evaluation action updates policy or checkpoint state.
evaluation.restoreRule: Restore final training state before every case and branch; unchanged export hashes do not substitute for a verified live-state reset.
evaluation.sharedActionRandomness: Each case uses one privately derived uniform draw, shared across branches, disclosed to the auditor after sealing. Sampling uses a fixed candidate order and inverse CDF; the draw never enters any learner observation or prediction function.
evaluation.branchOrder: Deterministic seeded permutation per case, counterbalanced across cases.
evaluation.interventionRule: Constant uses a fixed two-token message; random uses a dedicated uniform stream per position; shuffled uses a role-local derangement of delivered two-token messages. Identical-token coincidences are preserved.

agentAllowed: candidate attribute observations in committed order
predictorForbidden: held-out combinations during fitting or selection
observationSchemas.claimBoundary: Code-path and input-boundary checks must establish this restriction for these cooperative learners. This is logical separation under a trusted process and operator, not resistance to a malicious shared-process agent.

chronology: Assign held-out stratum k prospectively from the primary index before training.
Train once on seen combinations and retain all attempted episodes.
Freeze policy and authenticated training-ledger cutoff.
Run validation fitting and selection on seen combinations without updates.
Prepare normal messages and all final-test branch schedules for seen and unseen cases.
Commit predictions, messages, identities and schedule before test receiver actions.
Restore identical pre-case state and execute paired branches.
claimBoundary: This outcome-blind deferred draft is not a registration, qualification, resource allocation, pilot, confirmatory result, replication, independent review, submission or publication. No stage packet is claimed before its allocation exists.
